scoring_justification: Checker recomputes ZT from transport CSV to cross-check consistency with the temperature-dependent ZT CSV, then evaluates the ZT ratio values against paper-reported gold and verifies the qualitative trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for ZT_H/ZT_W ratio at T=300 K and T=1000 K.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the maximum value of ZT obtained … is about 1.1 times larger … at room temperature' and 'The maxima of Max(ZT-H)/Max(ZT-W) … about 1.18 at T=1000 K' (Section 3, Fig. 6).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported values for the ZT ratio.

outputs.description: Electronic transport properties vs carrier concentration at 300 K for both phases. The checker will recompute ZT from these values and cross-check consistency with the T=300 K row of temperature_dependence_ZT.csv.

ZT values and ratio for H and W phases as a function of temperature at optimal doping. The checker will compare the ratio_ZT_HW values at T=300 K and T=1000 K against hidden reference values, and verify the qualitative temperature trend.

steps.description: Cross-check internal consistency: recompute ZT from electronic_transport.csv at T=300 K using given κ_ph and compare to the corresponding row in temperature_dependence_ZT.csv.
Evaluate ZT ratio at T=300 K and T=1000 K against paper gold values (1.1 and 1.18) with relative tolerance 0.10, and verify qualitative trend (ratio>1, first decrease then increase).
